svg.title: A day with Latte
svg.desc: Bacus Lee, software engineer in Singapore. One day with Latte the cat, in sumi-e ink: dawn is OkiPaca, an alarm you can only stop by getting up; the afternoon is HonPaca, an EPUB reader whose answers cite the page; the evening is AnyScore, sheet music that listens; night is for writing to me.
